# Goodbye

## The question we started with

::: {.custom-style style="font-size: 1.6em;"}
How do we live together peacefully in a society of dignified equals?
:::

## Four reasons we limit government

- It is organized coercive force
- Crisis stories outrun the long trend
- Even good people are not omniscient
- Losers need a future and rights after a loss

## What you can do with that

Recognize force.

Check the story.

Look for trade-offs.

Defend the rules that keep losers in the game.

## Thank you

::: {.custom-style style="font-size: 1.7em;"}
Go be hard to fool and decent to neighbors.
:::
